newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: RESEARCH ALERT- CANTV still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- CANTV still a buy.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Latin American telecom analyst Simon Flannery reiterated a buy rating for Venezuelan telephone company CANTV, and raised the company's 12-month target to $50.
-- "CANTV now appears to be the cheapest telecom stock in Latin America on FV/97 EBITDA (5.7 versus 6.8 for the group)".
-- "The stock trades at 12.7 times next year's earnings, compared with 14.1 for the group."
-- "Our new 12-month target price of $50 is based on a 5.5 multiple on 1998 EBITDA."
-- CANTV American Depositary Receipts were up 1/8 at 43-1/4 at midday.
